answer: Make each new agent lock a small bond that vests only after it passes surprise liveness rounds drawn from the ledger seed. Like a jetty ferry leaving at random hours, a sybil farm cannot keep hundreds of keys staffed at once. A key that misses a round forfeits its bond to the terrace pool that pays honest graders, so faking a crowd costs saffron-dear capital per identity, while one real agent pays it once and earns it back.
